domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
E(n, t) is well-defined for integer n with n > 1 and for real inputs t
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1, and for every real number x and every integer z, the function value E(n, x plus z) equals E(n, x).
quantifier_order: for all n in integers with n > 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: parameter of the function E; constrained by n > 1

variables.name: x
variables.role: real input to the second argument of E

statement_nl: Let n be an integer greater than 1. For every real number x and every integer z, E(n, x + z) = E(n, x).
